name: solo-website-system
description: Solo Website System (SWS): Cloudflare-native, Rust-powered open-source visual website builder.

scripts.render: cargo run -q -p sws-cli --features pack-hospitality -- build packs/hospitality/demo/venue.json core/public
scripts.render:check: cargo run -q -p sws-cli --features pack-hospitality -- build packs/hospitality/demo/venue.json core/public --check
scripts.sites:check:headers: node core/tools/check-headers.mjs --headers-file sites/landing/public/_headers && node core/tools/check-headers.mjs --headers-file sites/docs/public/_headers
scripts.lint:abc: cargo run -q -p sws-cli --features pack-hospitality -- check packs/hospitality/demo/venue.json
scripts.lint:clippy: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p sws-cli --features pack-hospitality --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p sws-security -p sws-worker-site -p sws-wasm -- -D warnings
scripts.verify: npm run render:check && npm run sites:check && npm run lint:abc && npm run lint:abc:fixture-negative && npm run check:headers && npm run sites:check:headers && npm run test:unit && cargo test --workspace --locked && cargo test -p sws-cli --features pack-hospitality --locked && npm run lint:clippy && cargo deny check
scripts.verify:full: npm run render:check && npm run sites:check && npm run lint:abc && npm run check:headers && npm run sites:check:headers && npm run test:unit && npm run test:agents && npm run bootstrap:devvit && npm run test:devvit && cargo test --workspace --locked && cargo test -p sws-cli --features pack-hospitality --locked && npm run lint:clippy && cargo deny check
